issues.description: The template class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit defines a method named build_grover(...) but the run() method calls grover_circuit(...). The solution implementation and expected usage use grover_circuit(...). This name/signature mismatch will cause AttributeError for students running the template and will confuse them about which method to implement for Exercise 1.5.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template and run() consistent with the solution and problem intent: rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...), or change run() to call build_grover(...). Preferably rename build_grover to grover_circuit to match the solution and exercise wording so students implement the expected method name.

issues.description: The template defines the Grover circuit builder method as build_grover(...) but the rest of the materials (the template's run() method, the problem statement task name, and the solution) expect a method named grover_circuit(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation (constructing the Grover circuit for Exercise 1) creates confusion and will cause students' code or automated tests to fail or be hard to map to the instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (or change the run() call to use build_grover) so the template method name matches the problem/task name and the solution implementation. Update the method docstring to match the Exercise 1.5 description.
